run.name: Baytex Energy Corp.
run.title: CP-OS host session (BTE)
run.summary: Baytex has very little debt, strong liquidity and wide covenant headroom today. Its credit quality rests on a cash buffer that management can spend and on oil prices it does not control. Launched through CP-OS as of 2026-11-05 on the retained context; the EDGAR registrant name in that context is BAYTEX ENERGY CORP..

leverage.basis: Total debt / EBITDA. Calculated C3: Total Debt C$95.5m over Bank EBITDA C$758.9m; net cash C$566.286m over the same Bank EBITDA (negative sign means net cash). Company-printed ratio is 0.1. Bank EBITDA is company-defined, trailing twelve months, pro forma for dispositions; net cash is a company capital-management measure that nets working capital.

coverage.basis: EBITDA / cash interest. Calculated C4: Bank EBITDA C$758.9m over financing and interest expense C$81.5m (company-printed 9.3). Credit-agreement measure, not cash interest; the trailing twelve months still contain pre-repayment quarters, while actual Q2 2026 net cash interest was income of C$702 thousand.

gaps: Host session: an agent answered every module from the pinned filings and CP-5 is its own review. No independent review has been made. Treat the analysis as candidate.
CP-2 main limitation: Debt agreements, ownership and sale documents are missing, and the company reports no EBITDA, so leverage rests on company-defined measures.
CP-1 main limitation: Debt agreements and audited annual statements are not in the pack, and 2025 comparatives mix reporting bases, so terms and trends rest on company summaries.
